name: mi-billetera
description: Mi Billetera: digital wallet for W3C Verifiable Credentials on Stellar testnet

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @mi-billetera/api -w @mi-billetera/wallet
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint -w @mi-billetera/api -w @mi-billetera/wallet
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @mi-billetera/api -w @mi-billetera/wallet
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
